svg.title: Phase 5 prescribed exercise presentation mockups
svg.desc: Mobile and desktop workout views with a YouTube thumbnail, separately labelled prescription fields, verbatim multiline cues, execution logging, and a non-YouTube fallback.

g.text: Make the trainer's target readable at a glance, keep cues verbatim, and let the demo video support form review without taking over the logging flow.
Labels clarify meaning; values remain the trainer's exact strings. No parsing “12 · 15 kg · 45–60 sec” back out of a combined sentence.
Pakai dumbbell 1 pc, dipegang di tengah
Line breaks and bullets preserved from the Sheet
Blank lines and indentation remain visible
Fields that were not prescribed are omitted.
One visual hierarchy across current and historical sessions.
Derive a thumbnail from its video ID.
The database already keeps separate strings:
Sets · Reps · Load · Rest · RIR · Tempo
Render each string under its own label.
Do not infer units, ranges, or equipment.
Omit null fields instead of showing empty boxes.
Execution inputs stay separate and empty.
The exercise remains usable when thumbnail
loading fails; the demo link is never the only
Tap thumbnail → open YouTube in a new tab.
Set editing remains immediate and unchanged.
Buttons retain the existing pressed-state feedback.
03 · DESKTOP · MEDIA, PRESCRIPTION, AND CUES REMAIN DISTINCT
Pakai dumbbell 1 pc, dipegang di tengah
Bangun menggunakan outer sole dan ball of foot
On desktop, the video and the prescription sit side by side; execution remains below the exact same exercise identity.
